metadata.question: Does the vegetation browning in Denmark increase in July 2018 compared to July 2017?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Location: Denmark boundary from FAO GAUL level0.
- Date: July windows: 2017-07-01 to 2017-08-01, and 2018-07-01 to 2018-08-01.
- Collections: Primary COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED; fallback to COPERNICUS/S2_SR; then LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2.
2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds and cirrus (Sentinel-2 QA60 bits 10 & 11).
- Landsat L2: mask cloud and cloud shadows via QA_PIXEL bits.
- Compute NDVI and median composite for each month/year.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty after all fallbacks: C1.
- If valid pixels after masking are 0: C2.
- If NDVI mean is null or outside [-1, 1]: C3.
- Compare mean NDVI(2018) vs 2017 with a small tolerance (0.02). Lower in 2018 => browning increased => A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const gaul = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0');
    const denmarkFeat = gaul.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Denmark')).first();
    const denmark = ee.Feature(denmarkFeat).geometry().buffer(0);
    const scale = 1000;

    function fmt(num, d=3) {
      if (num === null || num === undefined) return 'NA';
      return Number(num).toFixed(d);
    }

    function s2MaskSR(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA60');
      const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10;
      const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11;
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0));
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }

    function l8MaskL2(img) {
      // QA_PIXEL bits: 3 = Cloud, 4 = Cloud shadow
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0);
      const cloudShadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0);
      const mask = cloud.or(cloudShadow).not();
      const scaleF = 2.75e-5;
      const offset = -0.2;
      const refl = img.select(['SR_B4','SR_B5']).multiply(scaleF).add(offset);
      const ndvi = refl.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5','SR_B4']).rename('NDVI');
      return ndvi.updateMask(mask);
    }

    function buildS2Composite(datasetId, start, end, geom) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId)
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .filterDate(start, end);
      const count = col.size();
      const meanCloud = col.aggregate_mean('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE');
      const ndviCol = col.map(s2MaskSR).map(function(img) {
        const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI');
        return ndvi.copyProperties(img, ['CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE']);
      });
      const composite = ndviCol.median().select('NDVI');
      return {col, count, meanCloud, composite, source: datasetId};
    }

    function buildL8Composite(start, end, geom) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .filterDate(start, end);
      const count = col.size();
      // Prefer CLOUD_COVER_LAND if available, else CLOUD_COVER
      const meanCloudLand = col.aggregate_mean('CLOUD_COVER_LAND');
      const meanCloud = ee.Algorithms.If(meanCloudLand, meanCloudLand, col.aggregate_mean('CLOUD_COVER'));
      const ndviCol = col.map(l8MaskL2);
      const composite = ndviCol.median().select('NDVI');
      return {col, count, meanCloud: ee.Number(meanCloud), composite, source: 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2'};
    }

    async function getYearStats(year, geom) {
      const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 7, 1);
      const end = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 8, 1);

      // Try S2 SR Harmonized
      let res = buildS2Composite('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED', start, end, geom);
      let size = await res.count.getInfo();
      if (size === 0) {
        // Fallback to legacy SR
        res = buildS2Composite('COPERNICUS/S2_SR', start, end, geom);
        size = await res.count.getInfo();
      }
      if (size === 0) {
        // Fallback to Landsat 8 L2
        res = buildL8Composite(start, end, geom);
        size = await res.count.getInfo();
        if (size === 0) {
          return {status: 'C1', year, source: 'None', images: 0};
        }
      }

      const meanCloud = await ee.Number(res.meanCloud).getInfo();
      const comp = res.composite.clip(geom);

      const countDict = await comp.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).getInfo();

      const meanDict = await comp.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).getInfo();

      const validPixels = countDict ? countDict['NDVI'] : 0;
      const ndviMean = meanDict ? meanDict['NDVI'] : null;

      return {
        status: 'OK',
        year,
        source: res.source,
        images: size,
        meanCloud: meanCloud,
        validPixels: validPixels || 0,
        ndviMean: ndviMean
      };
    }

    console.log('Region: Denmark (GAUL), scale: 1000 m');

    const stats2017 = await getYearStats(2017, denmark);
    const stats2018 = await getYearStats(2018, denmark);

    // Handle empty collections
    if (stats2017.status === 'C1' || stats2018.status === 'C1') {
      console.log(`2017 Images: ${stats2017.images || 0}, 2018 Images: ${stats2018.images || 0}`);
      console.log('At least one year has no images in date/location.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Print collection info
    console.log(`2017 Source: ${stats2017.source}, Images: ${stats2017.images}, Mean cloud%: ${fmt(stats2017.meanCloud, 2)}`);
    console.log(`2018 Source: ${stats2018.source}, Images: ${stats2018.images}, Mean cloud%: ${fmt(stats2018.meanCloud, 2)}`);

    // Handle no valid pixels
    if (stats2017.validPixels === 0 || stats2018.validPixels === 0) {
      console.log(`2017 Valid px: ${stats2017.validPixels}, 2018 Valid px: ${stats2018.validPixels}`);
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Validate NDVI means
    const ndvi2017 = stats2017.ndviMean;
    const ndvi2018 = stats2018.ndviMean;

    if (ndvi2017 === null || ndvi2018 === null || isNaN(ndvi2017) || isNaN(ndvi2018) ||
        ndvi2017 < -1 || ndvi2017 > 1 || ndvi2018 < -1 || ndvi2018 > 1) {
      console.log(`NDVI means invalid. 2017: ${ndvi2017}, 2018: ${ndvi2018}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`2017 Valid px: ${stats2017.validPixels}, NDVI(mean of median): ${fmt(ndvi2017, 3)}`);
    console.log(`2018 Valid px: ${stats2018.validPixels}, NDVI(mean of median): ${fmt(ndvi2018, 3)}`);

    const delta = ndvi2018 - ndvi2017;
    console.log(`Delta NDVI (2018-2017): ${fmt(delta, 3)}`);

    // Final decision: Browning increased if NDVI decreased in 2018 vs 2017 beyond small tolerance
    const tol = 0.02;
    if (delta < -tol) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
